title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
읽기 / Read first: the cumulative Korean EGA reader. This exact release covers EGA I front matter and introduction and EGA 0_I through §4.1.7. The full Korean EGA corpus continues in this one language lineage.

DataCite intent: this Korean edition IsTranslationOf and IsPartOf the stable global/source EGA object at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20414353. Full provenance and relation sidecars are included.
